previous_round.development_status: Adaptive exploration after both prior rounds; none of these historical intervals is an untouched holdout.

request: Test implementation stability and mechanically specified portfolio combinations, without changing completed research rules or target metrics.

sources.title: Portfolio Selection
sources.adaptation: Covariance diversification is the general motivation, not an attribution of these exact ETF allocations or rebalance thresholds to the paper.

sources.title: Toward Maximum Diversification
sources.adaptation: The already frozen maximum-diversification component is retained without modification.

methodology.observation: All observations are completed NYSE month ends. Quarterly means only March, June, September and December month ends; no historical date exceptions.
methodology.target_band: Emit the unchanged inverse-volatility target only when some target component differs by at least five percentage points from the last issued target. This is target-change hysteresis, not a claim to monitor actual account drift or an optimal trading band.
methodology.static_controls: Monthly fixed QLD/GLD weights. One-third/two-thirds is equal approximate underlying notional because QLD targets daily 2x exposure; one-half/one-half is equal fund dollars. Neither fraction is fitted.
methodology.ensembles: Fixed equal mixture of the first-round monthly inverse-volatility QLD/GLD allocation and the second-round minimum-variance or maximum-diversification allocation. Combine targets before trading one account; do not average separately compounded CAGRs.
methodology.costs: Retain USD10,000 capital, 2% idle cash, 5bp or 20bp per side and USD1 per order; execute at the next open or one further session under stress.
methodology.leverage: Every configuration can hold actual QLD; embedded leverage and maximum drawdown remain fully disclosed. No account borrowing, synthetic prices, shorting or trading authority.
methodology.selection_bias: Combinations were proposed after seeing component outcomes. A successful historical metric is not independent future alpha; report all 72 registered configurations and failed stress/chronological checks.
methodology.parameter_search: Only these six configurations. No grid search, fraction optimization, altered costs or retrospective rewriting of either prior round.
